messages.subject: gsoc 26 app done
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,
Today I submitted an application for R project in GSOC 26.
Mentors please add your project idea to
https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2026/wiki/table-of-proposed-coding-projects
— the sooner the better, if you want to find a good contributer.
Thanks!!
Toby
